entry.title: Desktop Icon Dock 1.1.2
entry.content:
Desktop Icon Dock

Turns shortcuts, files and folders that you drag onto it into a centered macOS-style dock. The dock is an independent list, not a mirror of the desktop. A fully transparent background is used by default, showing only the icons; an optional Liquid Glass panel is available.

Example: icons arranged as a centered macOS-style dock; the hovered icon is magnified with its label shown.

Features

  • Drag to add: drag a shortcut, file or folder from the desktop, File Explorer or a shell:Desktop window onto the dock. It is inserted at the drop position; items that are already in the dock are ignored. .lnk and .url shortcuts are copied into a dock-owned folder, so deleting the original shortcut from the desktop leaves the dock item intact; files, folders and virtual items are referenced by path.
  • Drag to reorder: hold the left mouse button on an icon and drag it within the dock. Icons rearrange live and the new order is saved when you release the button.
  • Drag out to put back on the desktop: drag an item outside the dock and release it over the desktop. The icon is placed at the release point. If the item already lives on the desktop, its original icon is moved there; otherwise a shortcut is created on the desktop and the original file or folder stays where it is. For a shortcut that was copied into the dock, the original shortcut is used, so dragging it out does not create a second (2) copy. Releasing over any other window leaves the item in the dock. Items that have no filesystem location, such as the Recycle Bin, are only removed from the dock. A dock-owned shortcut copy is removed after it has been placed back. Removing the last item brings back the empty-state hint.
  • Empty state: a visible drop target is shown when the list is empty, so the dock can always receive the first item. The window is never hidden just because the list is empty.
  • macOS-style hover magnification: icons grow smoothly as the pointer approaches, with cosine falloff and neighboring icons spreading aside.
  • Transparent background (default): only the icons and a soft drop shadow are drawn, so the dock blends into the wallpaper; transparent areas of the dock window are click-through, so desktop right-click and clicks keep working.
  • Optional Liquid Glass panel: enabled by turning off "Transparent background". Blurred wallpaper backdrop, milky glass tint, specular rim and a hover glow. The backdrop is sampled from the screen above the dock and works with Wallpaper Engine and other animated wallpapers.
  • Name labels: hovering an icon shows a name pill above it; in transparent mode the pill stays at a fixed position instead of jumping while icons scale.
  • Native interaction: left click opens an item; right click opens that item's native Explorer context menu (open, send to, create shortcut, properties, delete, …).
  • Independent from the desktop: adding, removing, renaming or moving desktop icons does not change the dock. Shortcuts added to the dock are copied into its own folder, so even deleting them from the desktop does not affect the dock; files, folders and virtual items are referenced by path. The list is stored per user in Windhawk's mod storage and survives Explorer restarts.
  • Original desktop icons hidden in memory (optional): when enabled, the desktop's list view is hidden while the dock is active; no Explorer setting or registry value is changed, and the icons are shown again when the mod is unloaded. Off by default, so the desktop remains available as a drag source.
  • Icon cache with cleanup: icons are cached per item path and reused; virtual items such as the Recycle Bin refresh their icons periodically.

How it works

The dock keeps its own ordered list. It does not read or rearrange the system desktop icons.

  • Storage: the ordered list is saved as items.tsv in Windhawk's mod storage, in a subfolder named after the current user's security identifier (SID), so each Windows user keeps a separate list. Each entry is a desktop-absolute parsing name, such as a full file path or a shell GUID for virtual items, followed by the original path for copied shortcuts. Shortcut copies live in the Items subfolder of the same directory. Every add, reorder and removal is written immediately. Windhawk removes the whole storage folder when the mod is uninstalled.
  • Adding: external drags are received through an OLE drop target (IDropTarget), supporting file drops and shell item lists. The insertion position follows the pointer; .lnk and .url shortcuts are copied into the dock folder first. Duplicates are skipped by parsing name. The drop is processed after the drop has been accepted, so a slow or unreachable path does not freeze the drag source.
  • Reordering and removing: these are handled inside the dock window with mouse capture, so they also work in the transparent gaps between icons.
  • Putting items back on the desktop: releasing outside the panel over the desktop places the item at the release point; releasing over any other window snaps it back into the dock. An item whose parent folder is already the user or public desktop has its original icon repositioned through the desktop's folder view; for a copied shortcut the original shortcut path is used. Any other file or folder gets a uniquely named .lnk shortcut on the user desktop (a source .lnk or .url is copied, other items get a new shortcut). The original file is never moved or deleted, and a dock-owned shortcut copy is removed after it has been placed back. Positioning follows the system "align icons to grid" setting.
  • Empty state: the centered hint pill is drawn with a non-transparent background and is registered as part of the same drop target.
  • Layout: centered horizontally at the bottom of the primary monitor, above the taskbar; the panel widens as items are added, and icons are vertically centered at rest.
  • Maintenance: every 30 seconds, entries that failed to resolve earlier are retried and the icons of virtual items are refreshed. Items that still cannot be resolved are skipped on screen but kept in storage.
  • Performance: in transparent mode the pointer position is polled every 50 ms so hover magnification also works in the gaps between icons; idle CPU usage is negligible.

Settings

| Setting | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | Icon size | 48 | Base size in pixels at 100% DPI, scaled with system DPI (about 72 px at 150%) | | Icon spacing | 10 | Pixel gap between icons at rest | | Maximum scale (%) | 175 | Largest magnification of the hovered icon | | Effect radius | 160 | Distance in pixels over which magnification fades out from the cursor | | Neighbor spread (%) | 60 | How much neighboring icons move aside while magnifying | | Smoothing speed | 16 | Higher is snappier, lower is softer | | Bottom offset | 10 | Gap between the dock and the taskbar, in pixels at 100% DPI | | Transparent background | On | Show only the icons; turn off to use the Liquid Glass panel | | Glass opacity (%) | 24 | Glass mode only: strength of the milky tint | | Glass blur | 20 | Glass mode only: backdrop blur strength | | Show labels | On | Show a name pill for the hovered item | | Hide original desktop icons | Off | Hide the system desktop icons while the dock is active by hiding the desktop list view in memory; they are shown again when the mod is unloaded | | Backdrop refresh interval (s) | 20 | How often the blurred backdrop (used by the glass panel and the label pill) is re-sampled; 0 disables refresh |

How it differs from existing mods

This mod overlaps with Quick Launch Dock in the basic launcher behavior: drag in, reorder, click to launch, a persistent list. It exists separately because it targets a different use case: a dock that is part of the desktop, not a launcher that stays on top of other windows.

  • Desktop level: the window sits at the bottom of the Z-order, below all normal windows, and never takes focus. It is visible when the desktop is visible, like the desktop icons themselves.
  • Drag out to the desktop: items can be dragged from the dock back to the desktop, reusing the original shortcut when it is still there instead of creating a duplicate.
  • Desktop integration: hiding the system desktop icons in memory and opening the native Explorer context menu both work with the shell's desktop view from the mod's own process, without injecting into the running shell.
  • Screen-sampled glass: the backdrop and the name pills sample the screen area behind the dock, which requires a desktop-level window.

Compatibility and limitations

  • Windows 10 / 11 on x86-64 only. The mod runs as a Windhawk tool mod in a dedicated explorer.exe process, separate from the shell's own explorer.exe; the shell is only accessed through its published shell interfaces. (The windhawk.exe host cannot be used here: Windhawk is a 32-bit app, while this mod is x86-64.)
  • Primary monitor only; the dock is anchored to the bottom of the primary monitor, above the taskbar.
  • The dock is a layered window placed below normal windows; full-screen apps and other windows cover it, which is expected.
  • In transparent mode, fully transparent pixels are click-through; the icons themselves remain clickable.

Troubleshooting

  • After an Explorer restart: the dock runs in its own dedicated explorer.exe process, so a shell restart does not unload it; it reconnects to the new desktop view and reapplies the icon hiding.
  • An item disappeared: its stored parsing name could not be resolved (for example, the referenced file or folder was deleted or renamed). Shortcuts are copied into the dock folder and are not affected by deleting the desktop shortcut. The entry is kept in storage and retried; it reappears if the path is available again.
  • After dragging an item out, a shortcut appeared on the desktop: this is expected. Items that are not on the desktop are not moved; a shortcut is created at the release point instead. The original file or folder is not affected, and the shortcut can be deleted at any time.
  • Settings changes seem to have no effect: saving settings reloads and rebuilds the dock automatically; no Explorer restart is needed.
  • Add an item: drag it from the desktop or any File Explorer window onto the dock. You can also press Win+R and enter shell:Desktop to open a desktop folder and drag from there.
  • Reset the list: drag the items out, or uninstall the mod. Windhawk deletes the mod's storage, including the list and the shortcut copies, when the mod is removed.

中文说明

本模组把快捷方式、文件和文件夹变成一个居中的 macOS 风格 Dock，默认使用全透明背景；关闭“透明背景”后会显示液态玻璃面板。

  • 从桌面、资源管理器或 shell:Desktop 窗口把项目拖到 Dock 上即可添加，落点决定插入位置，重复项目会被忽略。快捷方式（.lnk / .url）会复制到 Dock 自己的目录，删除桌面上的原快捷方式不影响 Dock；文件和文件夹按路径引用。
  • 按住图标在 Dock 内拖动可实时排序；拖到 Dock 外、在桌面上松手会把项目放回桌面，图标落在松手位置。项目原本就在桌面上时移动原图标；否则在桌面新建指向它的快捷方式，原文件或文件夹保持原位；对于复制进来的快捷方式会优先使用原快捷方式，不会产生多余的 (2) 副本；在其他窗口上松手则项目留在 Dock。回收站等虚拟项目仅从 Dock 移除；Dock 副本在放回桌面后删除。移除最后一项后显示空状态提示。
  • Dock 是独立列表，不同步桌面；列表保存在 Windhawk 模组存储的 items.tsv 中，并按当前用户 SID 分目录，顺序即显示顺序，重启 Explorer 后保持；快捷方式副本位于同一目录的 Items 子目录。卸载模组时 Windhawk 会删除整个存储目录。
  • 图标支持悬停放大、相邻图标让位和名称标签；左键打开，右键打开资源管理器原生菜单。
  • “隐藏原始桌面图标”默认关闭；开启后仅在内存中隐藏桌面列表视图，卸载模组后自动恢复。
  • 解析失败的项目会跳过显示但保留在存储中，每 30 秒只重试此前失败的项目；回收站等虚拟项目的图标会定期刷新。
  • 与 Quick Launch Dock 等启动器 Dock 的区别：本模组位于桌面层级（所有普通窗口之下）、不抢焦点，支持把项目拖回桌面并复用原快捷方式，还提供隐藏系统桌面图标和屏幕采样玻璃背景；这些行为通过 Shell 桌面视图完成，模组本身运行在独立的 explorer.exe tool-mod 进程中，与正在运行的 Shell 进程分离（Windhawk 主程序为 32 位，无法承载本 x86-64 模组）。
  • 仅支持 x86-64 的 Windows 10/11，且只在主显示器底部显示。

各设置项的说明见上方英文表格。

entry.title: Background Dimmer 1.0.0
entry.content:
Background Dimmer

Dims inactive windows so the active one stands out, while the background stays readable. Especially useful when working with windows side by side.

The dimming layer can be a solid tint, checkerboard, horizontal, vertical or diagonal stripes, or a tiled image of your choice. Opacity, brightness, contrast, pattern size and base color are all adjustable.

Windows that run as administrator need Windhawk 2 (currently in alpha). On Windhawk 1.x the layer can't move behind them, so when one of them gets focus, the previously active window stays undimmed.

Live configuration

The look is tuned in the mod's own configuration window, where every change shows up immediately on screen. Open it with the configuration hotkey (Win+Ctrl+Alt+D by default, changeable in the mod settings).

The window also opens by itself the first time the mod runs. If the configuration hotkey is empty or already taken by another program, it opens whenever the mod settings are saved. When it opens this way, without a keypress, Windows may keep it behind other windows: look for its flashing taskbar button.

Changes made in the configuration window are saved automatically. Dimming can be turned off with the Active checkbox in the window, or with an optional on/off hotkey.

How the controls work

  • Opacity: how strongly the layer covers the background.
  • Brightness: the overall lightness of the layer.
  • Contrast: the difference between the light and dark parts of a pattern. At 0 the pattern disappears into a flat tint.
  • Size: the size of the checkerboard squares or the width of the stripes, in pixels.
  • Base color: tints the layer. White gives neutral gray tones.

Brightness and contrast set the two pattern tones as brightness ± contrast / 2, so one controls how dark the layer is and the other how visible the pattern is. Near the ends of the range a tone is clipped to black or white, which keeps the pattern visible over a black base, as in the default look.

Behavior

  • Dialogs stay lit together with the window that owns them.
  • The taskbar, Start, Alt+Tab and menus never move the layer.
  • When the desktop has focus, the layer can either hide or cover everything (option in the configuration window).
  • The mod runs in its own Windhawk process and does not inject into Explorer or any other program.
  • Optionally, the layer can be left out of screenshots, recordings and screen sharing while it stays visible on your screen (Windows 10 version 2004 or later).
  • The appearance is stored per computer, so all Windows users of the same PC share it.

entry.title: Explorer Tab Router 1.1.1
entry.content:
Explorer Tab Router / 资源管理器页签路由

English

Explorer Tab Router keeps ordinary folder-opening requests together in Windows 11 File Explorer while preserving explicit requests for a separate window.

Behavior

  • Open a folder externally: reuse and activate an existing tab for that folder. If the folder is not open, route the new folder window into a tab in an existing Explorer window.
  • Show a file in its folder: activate the matching folder tab and preserve the requested file selection.
  • Open in new tab from a folder context menu: create a new tab and switch to it automatically, including when that folder already has another tab. Middle-click, background tab creation, and restored tabs keep their native activation behavior.
  • Open in new window: keep the explicitly requested window separate.
  • Hold Shift while opening a folder: bypass ordinary window-to-tab routing and keep a separate window.

Enable the mod in Windhawk, then use File Explorer and other applications normally. Folder routing and tab activation do not require a separate application list. Control Panel and unsupported shell locations are allowed to remain in their own windows.

Settings

Window routing, matching-tab reuse during routing, folder-menu new-tab activation, and ShellWindows lookup activation can be enabled independently. All four are enabled by default.

The lookup compatibility option is needed by some external folder-opening and file-reveal requests. The ShellWindows query interface does not say whether a caller intends to open a folder or only inspect it. With this option enabled, a successful read-only query can also switch tabs. Disable it if query-triggered activation is undesirable; some external requests will then no longer switch an existing tab. Delayed lookup activation is canceled if the user switches to another foreground window or selects a different tab before it runs.

Source and conflicting mods

This mod builds on the routing approach introduced by Explorer Single Window Tabs by ALMAS CP. It adds existing-tab reuse and activation, file-selection preservation, explicit-window handling, automatic new-tab activation, and managed presentation recovery.

Do not enable Explorer Single Window Tabs and Explorer Tab Router together. Disable the other routing mod first.

Compatibility and limitations

Windows 11 x64 with native File Explorer tabs is required. This mod uses internal shell symbols, which are checked when it loads. A future Windows update can require a compatibility update.

For routing between Explorer processes, use windows on the same desktop and at the same privilege level. Mixing ordinary and elevated Explorer windows is outside the supported configuration.

Ctrl+N and dragging a tab into a separate window can create frames without the explicit folder-menu intent this mod recognizes. Those frames may be routed back into tabs. Disable window routing when you need to retain them as separate windows.

Some requests are handled through a temporary transparent Explorer window before routing completes. This is not a guarantee of entirely window-free navigation. If a request cannot be completed safely, the temporary window is restored instead of discarding the request. Window presentation state, including existing layered transparency, is restored on recovery.

Tab activation uses verified position hints where available. A first activation or a tab reorder can still require intermediate tab switches. Activation has an overall time limit; a routing failure restores the original window. Navigation completion uses browser events with bounded direct-view checks for providers that omit events.

The mod is distributed under the MIT license.

简体中文

资源管理器页签路由将普通的文件夹打开请求集中到 Windows 11 资源管理器页签中，同时保留明确要求打开独立窗口的操作。

使用行为

  • 从外部应用打开文件夹： 已有相同目录页签时，复用并切换过去；尚未打开时，将新目录窗口转入现有资源管理器的页签。
  • 在文件夹中显示文件： 切换到对应目录页签，并保留目标文件的选中状态。
  • 文件夹右键菜单中的“在新标签页中打开”： 新建页签并自动切换，即使相同目录已有其他页签。中键、其他后台创建及启动恢复的页签保持系统原有的激活行为。
  • 在新窗口中打开： 保留明确请求的独立窗口。
  • 按住 Shift 打开文件夹： 绕过普通窗口转页签行为，保留独立窗口。

在 Windhawk 中启用后即可正常使用，不需要逐个添加应用名单。控制面板及不支持的 Shell 位置可以保持独立窗口。

设置

窗口转页签、路由时复用相同目录、文件夹菜单新页签自动激活、ShellWindows 查询命中后激活，可分别开关；默认全部启用。

查询兼容开关用于部分外部打开目录和文件定位请求。ShellWindows 查询接口不区分“打开文件夹”和“只检查是否已打开”，因此启用后，成功的纯查询也可能切换页签。若不希望查询触发切换，可关闭此项；部分外部请求也会因此不再自动切换已有页签。延迟执行查询激活前，若用户已转到其他前台窗口或切换了不同页签，会取消这次延迟激活。

来源与冲突提示

本 mod 基于 ALMAS CP 的 Explorer Single Window Tabs 路由思路扩展，增加已有页签复用与切换、文件选中保留、明确的新窗口请求识别、新页签自动激活，以及窗口状态恢复管理。

请勿同时启用 Explorer Single Window Tabs 与 Explorer Tab Router；启用前先停用另一个路由 mod。

兼容性与限制

需要 Windows 11 x64 以及支持原生页签的资源管理器。加载时会检查所需的系统内部符号，未来 Windows 更新可能需要同步更新兼容实现。

在资源管理器进程之间路由时，请使用同一桌面、相同权限级别的窗口；混用普通权限和管理员权限的资源管理器窗口不属于支持范围。

Ctrl+N 和将页签拖出为独立窗口，可能不携带本 mod 能识别的文件夹菜单意图，因此产生的窗口仍可能被合并回页签；需要保留这些独立窗口时，可关闭窗口转页签设置。

部分请求会先经过临时透明窗口，再完成页签路由，因此不保证整个过程完全不创建窗口。无法安全完成时会恢复临时窗口，避免丢弃打开请求；恢复时会还原原有窗口显示状态，包括已有的分层透明属性。

页签切换会复用经过验证的位置记录；首次切换或重新排序后仍可能短暂经过其他页签。激活设有总超时限制，路由失败时恢复原窗口。导航完成优先使用浏览器事件；缺少事件时只进行有限次直接视图检查。

本 mod 使用 MIT 许可。

entry.title: File Explorer Address Bar Home Button 1.0.3
entry.content:
File Explorer Address Bar Home Button

Adds a native WinUI 3 Home ("This PC") button directly adjacent to the Refresh button in the Windows 11 File Explorer address bar.

Features

  • Native WinUI 3 Integration: Injects an AppBarButton directly into File Explorer's address bar command bar (CommandBar#NavigationCommands) next to refreshButton.
  • Exact Visual & Theme Match: Inherits the native refreshButton's style, dimensions, margins, corner radius, and hover/pressed/focus visual states, dynamically matching Windows 11 Light, Dark, and High Contrast themes.
  • Active-Tab-Only Navigation: Uses COM Shell APIs (IShellWindows, IServiceProvider, IShellBrowser::BrowseObject, and IWebBrowser2::Navigate2) matched against the active ShellTabWindowClass child window so only the currently active tab navigates to This PC (shell:MyComputerFolder / ::{20D04FE0-3AEA-1069-A2D8-08002B30309D}).
  • Configurable Settings: Customize the target shell location, button placement (before or after the Refresh button), icon glyph (Home \uE80F or Computer \uE770), and tooltip text (This PC).
  • Clean Lifecycle: Supports live injection into open File Explorer windows (appearing immediately or on window focus), live settings updates, and clean removal on mod unload without leaking XAML elements or conflicting with other XAML mods.

entry.title: Taskbar RDP Launcher 1.4.0
entry.content:
• Change icons… in the right-click menu gives the widget's icons other glyphs from the Windows icon font: the computer and the display buttons. Choose an icon, then a glyph, or type its code; Default puts its own back.

entry.title: WinRAR Tweaks 1.0.0
entry.content:
WinRAR Tweaks

All-in-one quality-of-life enhancements for WinRAR that modernize navigation and file size readability without altering archive behavior.

✨ Features

  • ⌨️ Smart Close on Esc: Quickly close WinRAR with the Escape key—just like modern utilities and viewers. Intelligently respects active context menus, menu bars, dropdowns, inline file renaming, and child dialogs (closing open popups first before closing the main window).
  • 📊 Human-Readable File Sizes: Automatically converts hard-to-read raw byte counts (e.g., 121815) in the Size and Packed columns into clean, readable units (B, KB, MB, GB, TB).
  • ⚙️ Modular Settings: Toggle either tweak independently at any time in the mod's Settings tab.

🖼️ Previews

Human-Readable File Sizes

Smart Close on Esc

🛠️ How It Works

  • Modal & Input Guarding: Queries live Win32 thread GUI state (GetGUIThreadInfo) so Esc never interrupts active menu loops, drag/capture operations, dropdowns, or inline Edit rename boxes before sending WM_CLOSE.
  • In-Place ListView Formatting: Subclasses WinRAR's SysListView32 file list (both newly created and already-open windows) and formats raw byte counts on the fly as items are populated or refreshed.

⚠️ Compatibility & Notes

  • Refreshing After Changing Settings or Disabling: If you toggle the Human-Readable File Sizes setting on or off, or disable/remove the mod while WinRAR is open, please press F5 or navigate to another folder and back to refresh the file list with the updated size format.
  • Supported Column Languages: Out-of-the-box header detection supports English (Size, Packed) as well as common localized headers (Размер, Сжатый, Größe, Gepackt, Taille, Compressé, Tamaño, Comprimido).
  • Sorting Behavior: Because WinRAR sorts internal archive records prior to display formatting, sorting by Size or Packed continues to sort accurately by exact byte count.

🧩 More from this author

  • Drag to Scroll – Hold Ctrl + Right-Click and drag to scroll smoothly across desktop applications.
  • Explorer Custom Shortcuts – Customizable keyboard shortcuts for File Explorer: open terminal, copy paths, create files/folders, toggle hidden items, and launch apps with hotkeys.

Author & Attribution

  • Created and maintained by ArvindSaini978 (GitHub).

entry.title: Split Tray 1.4.8
entry.content:
• Drag application icons directly between Windows' primary notification area and Split Tray's embedded or floating trays.

  • Show the dragged icon, allowed cursor feedback, insertion lines and dimmed source ghosts. Reordering commits on release and cancels cleanly.

  • Coalesce icon refresh bursts and reuse maintained display geometry to avoid redundant taskbar work.

  • Improve Arrange with search, explicit order controls, per-icon rule reset, resizing, scrolling and DPI updates.

  • Share saved order and hidden choices across embedded and floating trays; refresh open overflow cells in place and protect taskbar space.

  • Improve screen-reader controls and touch/pen hold menus; make global shortcuts opt-in and off by default with Ctrl+Shift+F11/F12.

  • Integrate secondary overflow dragging, Show promotion for capacity overflow, and missed-release refresh recovery.

  • Respect swapped mouse buttons and preserve captured floating clicks through release.

  • Make private drag hooks optional so unavailable symbols do not disable the existing IconView constructor hook.

  • Preserve remembered order across tray transfers; promote only explicit Show and overflow-to-bar drags.

  • Improve overflow popup hit testing and unload cleanup; reuse the owned Arrange window handle.

entry.title: Bluetooth Auto Toggle 1.1.0
entry.content:
Bluetooth Auto Toggle

A Windhawk tool mod that automatically cycles Windows Bluetooth off and back on (in milliseconds) whenever Windhawk boots with your system and a connected Bluetooth device is detected.

Why this mod?

Some Bluetooth hardware adapters, drivers, and wireless peripherals (e.g., Bluetooth headphones, earbuds, mice, and keyboards) enter an unresponsive or degraded state on fresh system boots—even when Windows displays them as "connected"—causing audio silence, latency, or connection drops unless Bluetooth is power-cycled. This mod automates that process by waiting until a device is connected, pausing a configurable few seconds for the driver stack to settle, and cleanly cycling the Bluetooth radio off and then back on in the background.

Key Features

  • Device-Aware Activation: By default, only cycles Bluetooth when a connected Bluetooth device (headset, mouse, keyboard, etc.) is found.
  • Precise Millisecond Timing: Configurable startup delay, post-connection delay, and off-to-on toggle duration in milliseconds.
  • Dedicated Tool Mod Architecture: Runs in an isolated windhawk.exe background tool process without injecting into or hooking explorer.exe or any other critical system process.
  • Cold Boot Hardware Retry: Automatically retries radio enumeration if the Bluetooth service (bthserv) or adapter driver is still initializing during Windows boot.
  • State-Safe Cycling: Only toggles radios that are already powered ON (leaving radios in Airplane mode or turned off alone).
  • Safe Power Restoration: Minimizes the off window and ensures radios are commanded back on with retries even if the mod is unloaded mid-cycle.
  • Session-Safe: Remembers the current Windows logon session across tool process restarts using Windows Terminal Services (WTS) logon timestamps.
  • Graceful Lifecycle & Live Testing: Responsive to settings updates, mod reload, and instant cancellation on shutdown.

entry.title: Force Desktop Icon Spacing 1.1.6
entry.content:
Precisely control the desktop icon spacing: set the horizontal/vertical icon grid spacing and reserve a blank margin at the bottom of the icon area (above the taskbar).

How it works

  • The desktop list view (SysListView32) is subclassed (event-driven; the only polling is a one-time boot check that polls the icon count once a second for up to a minute after Explorer starts): every spacing request Explorer makes is transparently replaced with the configured values, and the icon area height is capped so it never enters the reserved bottom strip.
  • Values are absolute and applied in one pass: the same settings always produce the same layout, never cumulative drift.
  • The vertical grid is anchored at the top: increasing the vertical spacing stretches the grid downward, so the extra space is absorbed by the bottom region. No blank strip is created at the top, and the icon area is never shifted as a whole.
  • The bottom margin caps the icon area height only (the top edge stays fixed), so icon columns wrap earlier and never enter the reserved bottom strip.
  • All pixel values are scaled by the list view's DPI: the configured numbers apply at 100% scaling and scale up automatically on higher DPI.

Settings

  • Horizontal spacing (pixels): width of each icon grid cell, at 100% scaling. Larger = more horizontal gap between icons.
  • Vertical spacing (pixels): height of each icon grid cell, at 100% scaling. Larger = taller rows; the grid grows downward and the extra space is absorbed by the bottom region.
  • Bottom margin (pixels): blank strip reserved at the bottom of the icon area, above the taskbar, at 100% scaling. The icon grid never enters it. 0 = no reservation.
  • Rearrange icons on startup: arrange icons once when the mod loads and every time Explorer starts (sign-in, reboot, Explorer restart), so the spacing/margin take effect. Turn this off to keep icons where you place them by hand. Changes made in the settings always rearrange.

Notes

  • The grid cell size stays fixed when you change the icon size (Large/Medium/Small icons or Ctrl+wheel); adjust the spacing settings when you switch to Large icons, otherwise large icons may overlap their labels.
  • This mod doesn't write any registry values. If you want free icon placement, turn off "Auto arrange icons" and "Align icons to grid" in the desktop right-click menu yourself.
  • Disabling or unloading the mod restores the original icon spacing and the full icon area height. Icons stay where the mod arranged them (as with a manual "Arrange icons").
  • The bottom margin applies to the whole icon area (the list view spans all monitors); on multi-monitor setups it lands above the taskbar of the bottom-most monitor.

简体中文说明

精确控制桌面图标间距：自由调节图标网格的水平/垂直间距，并在图标区域底部（任务栏上方）预留空白边距。

工作原理

  • 通过子类化（事件驱动；唯一的轮询是资源管理器启动后长达一分钟、每秒一次的图标数量一次性开机检查）挂钩桌面列表视图（SysListView32）：资源管理器发出的每个间距设置请求都会被透明替换为配置值，图标区域高度被限制在预留边距之上。
  • 所有数值均为绝对值、一次性应用——同一配置永远得到同一布局，不存在多次叠加漂移。
  • 垂直网格顶端锚定：调大垂直间距时行距拉大、网格向下延伸，多余空间挤占底部区域——顶部不会产生空白，图标区域也不会被整体移动。
  • 底部边距只限制图标区域高度（顶边固定），图标换列提前，永不进入底部预留区。
  • 所有像素值按列表视图的 DPI 自动缩放：配置数值对应 100% 缩放，高 DPI 下自动放大。

设置项

  • 水平间距（像素）：图标网格单元宽度（100% 缩放下），数值越大图标水平间距越大。
  • 垂直间距（像素）：图标网格单元高度（100% 缩放下），数值越大行距越大，网格向下延伸，多余空间挤占底部区域。
  • 底部边距（像素）：图标区域底部（任务栏上方）预留的空白高度（100% 缩放下），图标网格不会进入该区域。0 = 不预留。
  • 启动时重排图标：模组加载时以及资源管理器每次启动时（登录、重启、重启资源管理器）各执行一次"排列图标"，使间距/边距生效。若希望保留手动拖放的图标布局，可关闭此项。在设置面板修改参数时始终会重排。

注意

  • 切换图标大小（大/中/小图标或 Ctrl+滚轮）时网格单元尺寸保持不变；切换到大图标时请相应调大间距设置，否则大图标可能与文字标签重叠。
  • 本模组不写入任何注册表值。如需自由摆放图标，请自行在桌面右键菜单中关闭"自动排列图标"和"将图标与网格对齐"。
  • 停用或卸载模组会自动恢复原始图标间距与图标区域完整高度；图标停留在重排后的位置（与手动"排列图标"一致）。
  • 底部边距作用于整个图标区域（列表视图横跨所有显示器）；多显示器下预留空白位于最底部显示器的任务栏上方。

entry.title: Language Switcher Position 1.3
entry.content:
Language Switcher Position

English

This mod allows you to customize the position of the modern Windows 11 26H2 input language switcher, which appears when clicking the language indicator (РУС / ENG) in the system tray.

Features

  • Left — positions the switcher at the left edge of the screen.
  • Center — positions the switcher in the center of the screen.
  • Right — positions the switcher at the right edge of the screen.
  • Custom X/Y — manually sets the window coordinates.
  • Vertical offset — provides additional vertical positioning control.

Screenshots

Settings

Horizontal position — selects the horizontal alignment: Left, Center, Right, or Custom X/Y.

Custom X coordinate — the horizontal window coordinate in pixels.

Custom Y coordinate — the vertical window coordinate in pixels.

Vertical offset — additional vertical displacement relative to the original Windows position. Used with Left, Center, and Right modes.

Compatibility

  • Windows 11 26H2
  • Windows Explorer (explorer.exe)
  • Modern XAML input language switcher.

Note

Positioning is calculated relative to the full monitor dimensions, including the taskbar area. Custom coordinates are specified in screen pixels.

The mod only changes the position of the switcher window and does not modify Windows input language settings.

Українська

Мод дозволяє змінювати положення сучасного перемикача мов введення Windows 11 26H2, який з'являється після натискання на індикатор мови (РУС / ENG) у системному треї.

Можливості

  • Left — розміщення перемикача біля лівого краю екрана.
  • Center — розміщення по центру екрана.
  • Right — розміщення біля правого краю екрана.
  • Custom X/Y — ручне налаштування координат вікна.
  • Vertical offset — додаткове вертикальне зміщення.

Налаштування

Horizontal position — вибір горизонтального розташування перемикача: Left, Center, Right або Custom X/Y.

Custom X coordinate — горизонтальна координата вікна в пікселях.

Custom Y coordinate — вертикальна координата вікна в пікселях.

Vertical offset — додаткове вертикальне зміщення відносно початкової позиції Windows. Використовується в режимах Left, Center та Right.

Сумісність

  • Windows 11 26H2
  • Windows Explorer (explorer.exe)
  • Сучасний XAML-перемикач мов введення.

Примітка

Позиціонування виконується відносно повного розміру монітора, включно з областю панелі завдань. Користувацькі координати задаються в екранних пікселях.

Мод змінює лише положення вікна перемикача та не впливає на системні налаштування мов введення.

entry.title: Taskbar Open Window Underline 2.1
entry.content:
Fixed

  • Icon underline color under per-taskbar theme overrides. The light/dark color was chosen from the Windows mode (SystemUsesLightTheme), so a taskbar that another mod had switched to the other theme — Top Taskbar Bleed does this through RequestedTheme when a light window is maximized — kept the wrong color. The theme is now read from the icon element's ActualTheme, which reflects the Windows mode as mirrored into the tree and any per-taskbar override, and colors are cached per theme.
  • All lines recolor together on a theme change. Each icon subscribes to its own ActualThemeChanged and recolors its line when it fires (a brush swap only; window state is left to the hooks and refresh passes). A single tree-root subscription was tried first and left buttons inconsistent, since it can run while some icons still report the old theme. Windows mode switches take the same path.
  • Fast double theme flips. A window that opens light and turns dark a few frames later (with Top Taskbar Bleed following it) could leave the line in the first theme until the button was next evaluated. A theme change now also requests a coalesced refresh pass (WM_APP_REQUEST_REFRESH, 60 ms plus the 300 ms follow-up) that re-reads every icon's settled theme.

Changed

  • Accent default is theme-shaded: AccentLight2 on a dark taskbar, AccentDark1 on a light one (the shades WinUI's accent fills use), so the line keeps its contrast on both themes. Setting description and README say so.
  • Each icon's ActualThemeChanged subscription is made once, with the winrt::event_token kept in the icon's entry; it is revoked when the option is turned off and on unload.
  • README: the icon underline's theme is the one each button is rendered with; the How-it-works bullet mentions ActualTheme.

Unchanged

Label underline, resolver, WinEvent handling and the running-indicator option are as in v2.0. The unload path gains only the revocation of the per-icon theme subscriptions.

entry.content:
